cues.name: First light
cues.description: A quiet blue wash with a gentle beam fan.

cues.name: Prism dance
cues.description: Six beams answer eight washes. A one-minute choreography.

cues.name: Afterglow
cues.description: A slow gold and lavender breathing look.

cues.name: Agent · Aurora
cues.description: Created and played through the MCP adapter.

cues.name: Moonlit Garden
cues.description: Peach ceiling washes, rose/lavender backlights and complementary patterned prism blooms. Uses verified MH7 beam mode and current calibrated positions.

cues.name: Neon Tidal Dance
cues.description: Scattered grid flashes travel back/front/back, backlights answer left/right/left, and staggered gobo/prism flashes ride opposing moving-head fans. Four color chapters, 60-second loop. Stop to fade out.

cues.name: Rig Check · All Lights
cues.description: All 48 mapped lights: steady warm/cool grid, violet/rose backlights, contrasting gobo/prism fans and gentle 65-second position drift. No flashes or lamp commands. Stop fades out.
